summary: Lost snowboarder evacuated from the Lime Creek drainage after leaving Blue Sky Basin
location: Lime Creek drainage (via Blue Sky Basin), Vail
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group + Vail Ski Patrol
notes: Vail Ski Patrol located the subject; two VMRG rescuers on snowmobiles transported him to vehicles at Vail Pass, then to Vail Village; out of the field by 6 p.m. Digest is a truncated RSS import — only the first mission summary is readable, so this is the sole extractable incident from that page. | Merged 2026-09-15: Jan-Feb 2016 VMRG mission digest repost (Vail Chamber) corroborates the Jan 15 Lime Creek snowboarder evac.
